import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync, realpathSync } from "node:fs";
import { createInterface } from "node:readline";
import { connectProbeRpc } from "<worktree>/skills/spec/tools/runtime/codex/probe-rpc";
import { isRecord } from "<worktree>/skills/spec/tools/core/frontmatter";

interface OwnedThread { id: string; cwd: string; turns: string[] }
interface Journal {
  createdAt: string; root: string; cwd: string;
  threads: Record<string, OwnedThread>; attempted: string[];
  observations: Record<string, unknown>; events: Record<string, unknown>[];
}
function record(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!isRecord(value)) throw Error("invalid native object");
  return value;
}
function records(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || !value.every(isRecord)) throw Error("invalid native array");
  return value;
}
function text(value: unknown): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string") throw Error("invalid native text");
  return value;
}
const location = record(JSON.parse(readFileSync("<controller-scratch>/location.json", "utf8")));
const root = text(location.root);
const cwd = text(location.workspace);
const journalPath = `${root}/execution-journal.json`;
if (existsSync(journalPath) && process.argv[2] !== "resume-owned") throw Error("refuse duplicate driver/journal");
const initialJournal: Journal = { createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), root, cwd, threads: {}, attempted: [], observations: {}, events: [] };
const journal: Journal = existsSync(journalPath) ? JSON.parse(readFileSync(journalPath, "utf8")) : initialJournal;
if (journal.root !== root || journal.cwd !== cwd) throw Error("journal ownership root changed");
const save = () => writeFileSync(journalPath, JSON.stringify(journal, null, 2) + "\n");
const connection = await connectProbeRpc({ url: `ws+unix://${text(location.socket)}`, timeoutMs: 5000, experimentalApi: true }, (frame) => {
  if (journal.events.length >= 500) throw Error("event bound exceeded");
  journal.events.push({ at: new Date().toISOString(), ...frame });
  save();
});
if (!connection.ok) throw Error(connection.reason);
const rpc = connection.value;
save();
async function call(method: string, params: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const response = await rpc.request(method, params);
  if (!response.ok) throw Error(`${method}: ${response.reason}`);
  return record(response.value);
}
function owned(label: string) {
  const thread = journal.threads[label];
  if (!thread || thread.cwd !== cwd) throw Error("not an owned isolated thread");
  return thread;
}
async function create(label: string) {
  if (journal.attempted.includes(label)) throw Error("creation already attempted");
  journal.attempted.push(label); save();
  const response = await call("thread/start", { cwd, ephemeral: false });
  const thread = record(response.thread);
  if (thread.cwd !== cwd || typeof thread.id !== "string") throw Error("native identity/cwd mismatch");
  journal.threads[label] = { id: thread.id, cwd, turns: [] }; save();
  journal.observations[`${label}-effective`] = { model: response.model, reasoningEffort: response.reasoningEffort, approvalPolicy: response.approvalPolicy, sandbox: response.sandbox };
  await call("thread/name/set", { threadId: thread.id, name: `Owned isolated resource execution ${label}` });
  return journal.threads[label];
}
async function inspect(label: string) {
  const thread = owned(label);
  const response = await call("thread/read", { threadId: thread.id, includeTurns: true });
  const current = record(response.thread);
  if (current.id !== thread.id || typeof current.cwd !== "string" || realpathSync(current.cwd) !== realpathSync(cwd)) throw Error("native identity/cwd changed");
  const turns = records(current.turns);
  if (turns.some((turn) => !thread.turns.includes(text(turn.id)) || turn.status === "inProgress")) throw Error("unowned or active continuation");
  return current;
}
async function snapshot(label: string) {
  const installed = await call("plugin/installed", { cwds: [cwd] });
  const skills = await call("skills/list", { cwds: [cwd], forceReload: true });
  const market = records(installed.marketplaces).find((row) => row.name === "phase1-execution-proof");
  const entries = records(skills.data).flatMap((row) => records(row.skills)).filter((row) => text(row.path).includes("phase1-execution-proof/spec-driven/"));
  const result = { at: new Date().toISOString(), marketplace: market, skills: entries };
  journal.observations[label] = result; save();
  return result;
}
async function shell(label: string, observation: string, command: string) {
  const thread = owned(label);
  if (thread.turns.length) await inspect(label);
  const eventOffset = journal.events.length;
  journal.observations[`${observation}-intent`] = { threadId: thread.id, command, at: new Date().toISOString() }; save();
  await call("thread/shellCommand", { threadId: thread.id, command, timeoutMs: 10000 });
  const deadline = Date.now() + 12000;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    const events = journal.events.slice(eventOffset);
    const completed = events.find((frame) => frame.method === "turn/completed" && isRecord(frame.params) && frame.params.threadId === thread.id);
    if (completed && isRecord(completed.params)) {
      const turn = record(completed.params.turn);
      thread.turns.push(text(turn.id));
      const result = { at: new Date().toISOString(), threadId: thread.id, command, events, turn };
      journal.observations[observation] = result; save();
      return result;
    }
    await Bun.sleep(50);
  }
  throw Error(`native shell completion not observed: ${observation}`);
}
async function account() {
  const response = await call("account/read", { refreshToken: false });
  const result = { at: new Date().toISOString(), accountPresent: response.account !== null, requiresOpenaiAuth: response.requiresOpenaiAuth };
  journal.observations.account = result; save();
  return result;
}
async function finish() {
  const archived: string[] = [];
  for (const [label, thread] of Object.entries(journal.threads)) {
    await inspect(label);
    const terminals = await call("thread/backgroundTerminals/list", { threadId: thread.id, limit: 20 });
    if (records(terminals.data).length || terminals.nextCursor) throw Error("native terminal remains; no archive");
    await call("thread/archive", { threadId: thread.id });
    archived.push(thread.id);
  }
  const result = { at: new Date().toISOString(), archivedThreadIds: archived, remainingTerminals: 0 };
  journal.observations.cleanup = result; save();
  return result;
}
if (process.argv[2] === "resume-owned") {
  for (const thread of Object.values(journal.threads)) await call("thread/resume", { threadId: thread.id, excludeTurns: true });
}
const input = createInterface({ input: process.stdin });
const expires = setTimeout(() => { rpc.close(); input.close(); }, 12 * 60000);
console.log(JSON.stringify({ ready: true, journalPath }));
try {
  for await (const line of input) {
    try {
      const request = record(JSON.parse(line));
      const action = text(request.action);
      let result: unknown;
      if (action === "create") result = await create(text(request.label));
      else if (action === "snapshot") result = await snapshot(text(request.label));
      else if (action === "account") result = await account();
      else if (action === "shell") result = await shell(text(request.label), text(request.observation), text(request.command));
      else if (action === "inspect") result = await inspect(text(request.label));
      else if (action === "finish") result = await finish();
      else throw Error("unknown controlled action");
      save();
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ action, result: action === "snapshot" ? { saved: true } : action === "shell" ? { saved: true, observation: request.observation } : result }));
      if (action === "finish") break;
    } catch (cause) {
      journal.observations.lastError = { at: new Date().toISOString(), reason: String(cause) }; save();
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ error: String(cause) }));
    }
  }
} finally { clearTimeout(expires); rpc.close(); input.close(); }
